en.title: Department of Justice: 75 references to U.S. Code sections repealed, omitted or not in the Code
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Department of Justice, 75 references in 53 sections cite a U.S. Code section that release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code does not carry in force: 48 cite a repealed section; 26 cite a number the Code does not have; 1 cites a section omitted from the Code. The release names no successor for these sections.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references does not reach the text the rule relies on. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides whether to remove or replace each reference. The U.S. Code names no successor for these sections.
